hypothesis: On identical dense LIBERO windows, adding tail-2 action-to-future-video gates to an output-head-trained H3/ActionDiT parent reduces held-out action error beyond the output-only control without harming video loss.
single_variable: The bidirectional arm adds only 112 trainable action-to-future-video gate scalars; initialization, seed, data order, action output training and losses are shared.
parent_baseline: A-arm: official H3-to-ActionDiT initialization with action output head only, 100 steps, seed 2026, v7 dense manifest.
